label: Species and pain weights inside Ambitious Impact's suffering-adjusted days

rows.label: Ambitious Impact's weight for a hen's suffering against a person's (2024 SADs)

source.title: ACE, Çiftlik Hayvanlarını Koruma Derneği CEA (2024), 'SADs Estimate' tab: Ambitious Impact's SAD calculation for cage-free
source.quote: Likelihood of hen sentience 0.805525; Welfare range of hens 0.57598
source.note: Ambitious Impact's own table (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bgnTeETRkpnyKZZXDhO5OBl6L2a0OYN1ntnYHL6vz34/edit, 2024 SADs tabs, row 'Layer hens') gives 0.80537 × 0.57598 = 0.46388, the same to three figures. Its 2025 tabs give 0.876 × 0.3965 = 0.347.

rows.explainer:
Ambitious Impact's suffering-adjusted days (SADs) count a hen's pain as a person's times this weight: an 80.6% chance hens are sentient times a welfare range of 57.6% if they are (0.806 × 0.576 = 46.4%). ACE copies Ambitious Impact's calculation into its sheet; 37.69 intensity-adjusted days × 46.4% gives the 17.49 SADs per hen moved out of a battery cage that ACE uses in 2024 and 2025.

Rethink Priorities' median for chickens is 33.2%. Our animal models take this weight out of ACE's SADs and put the chicken slider in its place, so one slider sets the chicken for every model.

rows.label: Ambitious Impact's weight for a shrimp's suffering against a person's (2025 SADs)

source.title: Ambitious Impact, sentience and welfare range estimates used in its SADs (2025 SADs tabs)
source.cell: Sentience estimates (2025 SADs)!G17 × Welfare range estimates (2025 SADs)!E17
source.note: 0.4328 × 0.46 = 0.199089, as Vasco Grilo also quotes (https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/waL3iwczrjNt8PreZ/announcing-ace-s-2025-charity-recommendations/comment/zssTWeCRzy4HogCrk). The 2024 tabs give 0.2987 × 0.6206; ACE's 2024 Aquatic Life Institute sheet rounds these to 30% × 62% = 18.6% ('SADs Estimate'!B12:B13).

rows.explainer:
The weight inside Ambitious Impact's 2025 SADs for shrimp: a 43.3% chance shrimp are sentient times a welfare range of 46.0% if they are, about 20% of a person. That is 0.57 of Ambitious Impact's 2025 hen weight (34.7%); Rethink Priorities puts a shrimp at 0.09 of a chicken.

From Ambitious Impact's published table of the weights inside its SADs (2025 version), which ACE's 2025 review of the Shrimp Welfare Project uses. The 2024 version in ACE's Aquatic Life Institute sheet was 18.6%.

rows.label: Ambitious Impact's weight for a pig's suffering against a person's (2024 SADs)

source.title: Ambitious Impact, sentience and welfare range estimates used in its SADs (2024 SADs tabs), linked from 'SADs (Suffering-Adjusted Days): an improved animal welfare measurement tool'
source.cell: Sentience estimates (2024 SADs)!G4 × Welfare range estimates (2024 SADs)!E4
source.quote: Pigs: New CE numbers (weighted average) 0.9141304348; CE numbers (weighted average) 0.69238
source.note: 0.91413 × 0.69238 = 0.632926. The 2024 tabs are the ones ACE's SADs use: the same tabs give a hen 0.80537 × 0.57598 = 0.4639, which reproduces ACE's 28.94 SADs per caged hen. Ambitious Impact's 2025 tabs give pigs 0.925 × 0.5575 = 0.516. Post: https://www.charityentrepreneurship.com/post/sads-suffering-adjusted-days-an-improved-animal-welfare-measurement-tool (now redirects; archived at web.archive.org).

rows.explainer:
The weight inside the suffering-adjusted days (SADs) ACE uses for pigs: a 91.4% chance pigs are sentient times a welfare range of 69.2% of a person's if they are, 63.3% in all. Ambitious Impact averages several sources for each: Rethink Priorities' welfare ranges with and without neuron counts, plus a 29% credence that welfare ranges shouldn't be used at all (a range of 1).

Against Ambitious Impact's 2024 hen (46.4%) a pig counts 1.36 times as much; Rethink Priorities' table puts a pig at 1.55 chickens. Our models divide this weight out of ACE's pig SADs and put Rethink's in.

rows.label: Ambitious Impact's weight for a fish's suffering against a person's (2024 SADs)

source.title: Ambitious Impact, sentience and welfare range estimates used in its SADs (2024 SADs tabs), linked from 'SADs (Suffering-Adjusted Days): an improved animal welfare measurement tool'
source.cell: Sentience estimates (2024 SADs)!G12, G14 × Welfare range estimates (2024 SADs)!E12, E14
source.note: Salmon 0.50518 × 0.52235 = 0.263882; fish in general 0.50582 × 0.55552 = 0.280992. ACE's meal figures count farmed fish, reptiles and amphibians as farmed salmon and wild-caught fish as the mean of salmon slaughter and cleaner fish (ACE, Global meal replacement estimates 2024, 'SADs per year (global)'!A2:F9). Best guess: the two weights mixed by those SAD shares (58% cleaner fish, taken as fish in general; 42% salmon), 2,600 / (1,509 / 0.281 + 1,091 / 0.264) = 0.273548. Which row Ambitious Impact used for cleaner fish isn't shown, hence the range.

rows.explainer:
The weight inside the suffering-adjusted days (SADs) ACE uses for fish: about a 50.6% chance fish are sentient times a welfare range of 52–56% of a person's if they are, 26–28% in all. Ambitious Impact gives salmon 26.4% and fish in general 28.1%; the fish in a replaced meal are a mix of the two.

Against Ambitious Impact's 2024 hen (46.4%) a fish counts 0.59 times as much; Rethink Priorities' table puts a farmed fish at 0.22 chickens. Our models divide this weight out of ACE's fish SADs and put Rethink's in.

rows.label: Ambitious Impact's weight for a hen's suffering against a person's (2025 SADs)

source.title: Ambitious Impact, sentience and welfare range estimates used in its SADs (2025 SADs tabs)
source.cell: Sentience estimates (2025 SADs)!G10 × Welfare range estimates (2025 SADs)!E10
source.note: 0.876 × 0.3965 = 0.347334. ACE's 2025 sheets (The Humane League, Animal Welfare Observatory, Shrimp Welfare Project) say they use 'our own 2025 SADs values, which are not directly comparable with 2024 SADs values'; ACE's 2025 SADs sheet (1AlQDf29GO67U7sP-wE3fLipQHCdRPBaVuWGph7kviOw) is private. That its weights are Ambitious Impact's 2025 ones is our inference, supported by the 2025 shrimp weight quoted for ACE's 2025 recommendations.

rows.explainer:
The hen weight inside ACE's 2025 SADs: an 87.6% chance hens are sentient times a welfare range of 39.7% of a person's if they are, 34.7% in all. Lower than the 46.4% inside the 2024 SADs: for 2025 Ambitious Impact uses only Rethink Priorities' 2022–23 sentience figures and gives no weight to not using welfare ranges at all.

Models divide each SAD figure by the weight of the version it was built with: 2025 figures (broilers under the Better Chicken Commitment, enriched cages to aviaries) by this one, 2024 figures by 46.4%.

rows.label: Ambitious Impact's weight for a shrimp's suffering against a person's (2024 SADs)

source.title: ACE, Aquatic Life Institute CEA (2024), 'SADs Estimate' tab: Ambitious Impact's SAD calculation for electrical stunning
source.quote: Likelihood of shrimp sentience 0.3; Welfare range of shrimps 0.62
source.note: 0.3 × 0.62 = 0.186, the weight inside ACE's 0.0973 SADs per shrimp stunned. Ambitious Impact's own 2024 tabs give 0.2987 × 0.6206 = 0.1854 (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bgnTeETRkpnyKZZXDhO5OBl6L2a0OYN1ntnYHL6vz34/edit, row 'Shrimp'); ACE rounded them.

rows.explainer: The shrimp weight inside 2024 SADs, as ACE used it for the Aquatic Life Institute: a 30% chance shrimp are sentient times a welfare range of 62% if they are, 18.6% of a person. Used to restate that 2024 figure on the 2025 basis of the shared per-shrimp fact; no model divides by it directly.

rows.label: An hour of annoying pain, as a share of an hour of disabling pain (Ambitious Impact)

source.title: ACE, Çiftlik Hayvanlarını Koruma Derneği CEA (2024), 'SADs Estimate' tab

rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact weighs pain by intensity: annoying pain counts 1, hurtful 6.6, disabling 31.6 and excruciating 374.5, so an hour of annoying pain is 1/31.6 of an hour of disabling pain. For reference; no model reads it.

rows.label: An hour of hurtful pain, as a share of an hour of disabling pain (Ambitious Impact)

source.title: ACE, Çiftlik Hayvanlarını Koruma Derneği CEA (2024), 'SADs Estimate' tab

rows.explainer: Hurtful pain is 6.6 on Ambitious Impact's scale and disabling pain 31.6, so an hour of hurtful pain counts as about a fifth of an hour of disabling pain. For reference; no model reads it.

rows.label: An hour of excruciating pain, in hours of disabling pain (Ambitious Impact)

source.title: ACE, Çiftlik Hayvanlarını Koruma Derneği CEA (2024), 'SADs Estimate' tab

rows.explainer: Excruciating pain is 374.5 on Ambitious Impact's scale and disabling pain 31.6, so an hour of excruciating pain counts as about 12 hours of disabling pain. Some researchers argue this is far too low. For reference; no model reads it.
